title.zh_CN: 连亏之夜：苏禾的热咖啡
title.en: Drawdown Night: Su He's Hot Coffee

text.zh_CN: （一杯温热的黑咖啡轻轻放在你的键盘旁）先别急着敲回车下单。我刚从后台风控屏看到你的账户净值出现了明显回撤——这个时候人的手指会比脑子快，最容易犯的致命错误叫‘报复性翻本（Revenge Trading）’。
text.en: (A warm mug of black coffee is set gently beside your keyboard) Hold off on hitting Submit. I saw the drawdown on your account monitor — right now fingers move faster than judgment, and the deadliest trap is Revenge Trading.

text.zh_CN: 回撤数学很残酷：亏掉 5% 只需要涨 5.3% 就能回本；但如果你上头满仓赌一把亏到 30%，就必须暴涨 42.9% 才能回到原点。我们量化台有一条铁律：净值跌破水线时，单笔风险预算自动减半，绝不逆势加码摊平亏损。
text.en: Drawdown math is unforgiving: a 5% loss needs +5.3% to recover, but tilt into a 30% hole and you need +42.9% just to break even. On our quant desk the rule is mechanical: below watermark, cut per-trade risk in half — never average down into a loser.

text.zh_CN: 亏损本身并不可耻，它是交易这门生意的正常营业成本。真正区分职业交易员和赌徒的，是你亏钱之后下一单的仓位大小。
text.en: Taking a loss isn't shameful — it's the normal cost of doing business in markets. What separates a professional from a gambler is the size of the very next order after a loss.

text.zh_CN: 喝口咖啡缓一缓，你打算如何执行接下来的回撤修复计划？
text.en: Take a sip of coffee and reset — how will you manage your drawdown recovery?

text.zh_CN: 主动缩减单笔仓位并挂好止损单，用小步胜率慢慢修复净值。
text.en: Cut position size and attach hard stops; rebuild equity step by step.

toast.zh_CN: 风控纪律：启动减半仓位回撤修复模式
toast.en: Risk discipline: Half-size recovery protocol engaged

text.zh_CN: 先转向宽基 ETF（MKT/DIV）稳住底仓，暂停高波动个股追涨杀跌。
text.en: Rotate into broad ETFs (MKT/DIV) to stabilize; pause high-beta chasing.

toast.zh_CN: 风控纪律：以稳健指数底仓重建节奏
toast.en: Risk discipline: Stabilizing book with core ETFs

text.zh_CN: 很好。只要本金还在牌桌上，复利永远站在守规矩的人这一边。早点休息，明天开盘前先看一眼持仓体检。
text.en: Good. As long as your capital stays at the table, compounding favors the disciplined. Get some rest, and check your portfolio risk diagnostics before tomorrow's bell.

text.zh_CN: 很聪明的降维处理。看不清个股暗流时，退回低费率指数基金让时间帮你缓冲，是成熟基金经理最常用的防守动作。
text.en: Smart de-escalation. When single-name currents get choppy, stepping back into low-cost index ETFs to regain rhythm is a classic portfolio manager defense.
